items.title: Mose Allison — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I met Lennie Tristano, and I shook hands with him.

ctx.x: Al Haig... You mentioned also George Wallington, who would help you, and Monk and Tristano. When you arrived in New York the second time, apart from the struggle of living in New York and raising a family, what was your impression of being there?
